summary: The root مَحَصَ (mHS) means to purify or clear something, like refining gold from impurities. In a spiritual sense, it refers to God purifying believers or purging sins.
lane: 2 محّصهُ ذ , inf. n. تَمْحِيصٌ , He rendered it clear, pure, free from every admixture or imperfection or the like; as also , aor. مَحَصَ , inf. n. مَحْصٌ . (Az, A, TA.) You say, مَحَّصَ الذَّهَبَ , (A, TA,) or , (S, K,) He cleared, or purified, the gold from what was mixed with it, (S, A, K,) i. e. from the earth, or dust, and dirt, (TA,) بِالنَّارِ by fire. (S, A, K.) -b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) He (God) purged, or purified it; namely a man's heart: and him; namely a man repenting. (A.) It is said in the Kur, [iii. 135,] وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللّٰهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمَنُوا (tropical:) And that God may purify those who believe: (TA:) or purge away the sins of those who believe: (Fr, TA:) or these words have another meaning, which see below. (TA.) It is also said in a trad., mentioning a sedition, or conflict and faction, or the like, يُمَحَّصُ النَّاسُ فِيهَا كَمَا يُمَحَّصُ ذَهَبُ المَعْدِنِ , i.e. (tropical:) Men shall be cleared therein, one from another, like as the gold from the mine is cleared from the earth, or dust. (TA.) تَمْحِيصُ الذُّنُوبِ signifies (tropical:) The purging of sins. (TA.) And you say, مَحِّصْ عَنَّا ذُنُوبَنَا , meaning (tropical:) Remove thou, or put thou away, from us our sins. (TA.) [But this phrase may be rendered somewhat differently; as will be seen below.] And ٱللّٰهُ مَا بِكَ , and مَحَّصَهُ ; i.e. (tropical:) May God remove, or put away, what is in thee. (TA.) -b3- [Hence, also,] (assumed tropical:) He tried, proved, or tested, him: (S, IAth, K:) and accord. to Ibn-'Arafeh, the verb has this meaning in the phrase quoted above from the Kur: [but he adds,] because the trial of the Muslims diminishes their sins: for (TA) تَمْحيصٌ also signifies The diminishing [a thing]. (Ibn- 'Arafeh, K.) You say, مَحَّصَ ٱللّٰهُ عَنْكَ ذُنُوبَكَ May God diminish thy sins. (TA.) -b4- And the clearing, or cleansing, flesh from sinews, (K, TA,) for the purpose of twisting them into a bow-string. (TA.)

headwords.def: [an inf. n. of which the verb is app. مَحَصَ, aor. مَحَصَ,) A thing's becoming, or being, clear, pure, or free from admixture. (TA.) See also 5, throughout. مَحَصَهُ: see 2, in three places. مَحَصَ, aor. مَحَصَ, (S, K,) inf. n. مَحْصٌ, (TA,) He (an antelope) ran: (S, K:) or ran vehemently: (TA:) or vigorously: (AA, TA:) or was quick, or swift, in his running; as also فِى عَدْوِهِ. (TA.) And hence, (TA,) مَحَصَ السَّيْرَ, [app.

inf. n. تَمْحِيصٌ, He rendered it clear, pure, free from every admixture or imperfection or the like; as also, aor. مَحَصَ, inf. n. مَحْصٌ. (Az, A, TA.) You say, مَحَّصَ ال َّهَبَ, (A, TA,) or, (S, K,) He cleared, or purified, the gold from what was mixed with it, (S, A, K,) i. e. from the earth, or dust, and dirt, (TA,) بِالنَّارِ by fire. (S, A, K.) [Hence,] (tropical:) He (God) purged, or purified it; namely a man's heart: and him; namely a man repenting.

[ It became clear, pure, free from every admixture or imperfection or the like; as also; and; and; and, q. v.] [Hence,] تمحّصت ُنُوبُهُ (tropical:) [ His sins became purged away ]. (A, TA.) And تمحّصت الظَّلْمَآءُ (tropical:) The darkness became cleared away, or removed. (A, TA.) And الشَّمْسُ, and, (K,) and, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) The sun appeared, and became clear, after an eclipse. (K, TA.) And الرَّجُلُ, (inf. n.
and إِمَّحَصَ: see 5, in two places.
One whose sins are put away from him: mentioned by Kr.: but he says, I know not how this is; for that which is مُمَحَّص is the sin [itself]. (TA.)
